evals.prompt: Create a rule that we always use bun for install, run, and test. Never npm or yarn. Don't add package-lock.json.
evals.expected_output: A root AGENTS.md section about the package manager. No .cursor/rules, no skill.
expectations: Writes or updates a root AGENTS.md
AGENTS.md tells agents to use bun and not npm or yarn
Does not create a SKILL.md for this always-on convention
Does not create .cursor/rules, a .mdc file, or CLAUDE.md

evals.prompt: Add a rule for the Next.js app in apps/web: before writing any Next code, read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/. This only applies to that app, not the rest of the monorepo.
evals.expected_output: A nested apps/web/AGENTS.md with the Next.js docs instruction. Root AGENTS.md is not the place for this.
expectations: Tells the agent to read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing Next code
Does not put the Next.js-only rule into the repo-root AGENTS.md
Does not create .cursor/rules or a .mdc file

evals.prompt: Create a rule for how we write oRPC v2 procedures — os builder, .input/.output/.handler, no v1 APIs. We don't need this in every conversation, only when someone is touching the API layer.
evals.expected_output: A project skill (SKILL.md) with a pushy description, not an always-on root AGENTS.md dump.
expectations: Creates a SKILL.md under a project skill root
Frontmatter includes name and a description that mentions oRPC or API procedures
Skill body describes os builder and .input/.output/.handler
Does not replace root AGENTS.md with the full oRPC playbook
Does not create .cursor/rules or a .mdc file
